Ana W.: Quick Q  if I end the year with ~52h PTO, how much carries over? Also any holiday rota rules for Dec 24-28?
Jared (People Ops): Hi Ana ":wave:" Standard carryover cap is 40 hours for FT. Anything above 40 expires after year-end unless an exception is approved.
Noah R.: Are there special rules for employees on international assignments?
Jared (People Ops): We prorate by country local law where applicable. If local law mandates different carry rules, payroll/legal will follow that. Otherwise Redwood policy (40h cap) applies.
Ana W.: If I need an exception because of travel in Jan, what's the process?
Jared (People Ops): Email people-ops@redwood.com with subject "PTO Carryover Exception - <Name>" including: 1) hours requested, 2) reason (brief), 3) proposed use-by date, 4) manager approval. We manually adjust Rippling if approved.
Noah R.: Any blackout or mandatory coverage in late Dec?
Jared (People Ops): Soft blackout Dec 20-Jan 2: coordinate with your manager. Certain mission-critical roles have mandatory rota (managers notified by Nov 20). Soft = not prohibited; mandatory rota = require coverage.
